# TDPdf v1.22.1.0

A fixes-only release. **If Insert Signature or Insert Text Box has been failing for you, this is the release that fixes it.**

## Insert Signature and Insert Text Box were crashing the app

They were not being ignored. Placing a signature or a text box could take the whole application down at the moment of the click — so the annotation never appeared, and the tool read as broken rather than as a crash. The report came in as "the tool does nothing", and the crash telemetry is what identified it.

The cause was a race inside the annotation overlay: the visual elements on it were being modified while Windows was still measuring them. TDPdf hit the same class of fault once before, in 1.8.1.0, on the page-grid panel. The guard written then covered only the shape that panel produced; the annotation overlay produces a different one and went unprotected.

Three separate faults were fixed, not one:

- The annotation overlay now carries the same protection the page grid has had since 1.8.1.0, and both share one guard covering both shapes of the race.
- Two real paths into the fault are closed at the source. Page overlays (links, form fields, additional pages) were queued at a priority that could land them *inside* the layout pass they were meant to follow. And the page viewer's scroll handler was firing for every scrollable control beneath it — including the live form fields drawn onto a page — which could change the selected page mid-layout. **Side effect worth knowing: scrolling inside a form field would previously jump you to another page. It no longer does.**
- The crash reporter was making it worse. This kind of error is classified as recoverable and the app should have carried on; instead the crash dialog opened from inside the failure, re-entered the same code, failed again, and shut the app down. Recoverable errors are now contained first and reported afterwards.

## Also fixed, from upstream KillerPDF v1.7.4

- **Form fields saved on a non-English Windows could produce an unreadable field appearance.** Numbers inside the generated field were formatted using the machine's regional settings, so on any locale that writes decimals with a comma — German, French, Spanish and most of Europe — the result was not valid PDF and strict readers refused to draw the field. Affects saved text fields, comb fields and checkboxes.
- **Filled form values were printed, flattened and exported twice**, one copy slightly offset from the other — the "ghost text" effect on filled forms. The on-screen version of this was fixed in 1.21.0.0; the output path had the same fault and now paints each field exactly once. Fields the document itself marks hidden still stay hidden.
- **A PDF opened while TDPdf was still starting could be silently dropped.** Double-clicking a file while a first window was still coming up handed the path to a window that was not ready for it. The path is now held and opened once startup finishes.
- **A damaged PDF dropped onto the Pages sidebar now offers to repair it.** Previously it was discarded without a word, so the file simply vanished from the drop with no explanation. Only the lossless repair is offered here — the one that keeps text, forms and bookmarks. TDPdf deliberately does not fall back to rebuilding the pages as images when appending: that would bury a run of flat, unsearchable pages inside your document with nothing to distinguish them.

## For administrators

The Intune detection rule now requires 1.22.1.0, so managed machines will pick this up on the next evaluation. Deployment assignments are unaffected.

## Verifying this download

The executable is signed by *The Doodle Project Code Signing*, a private certificate. On managed machines that trust it, the signature validates. On a machine that does not, Windows will still warn on first run. Use `SHA256SUMS.txt` if you want to confirm the download independently.
